dialogs.text: This is no way to continue doing business...
Is something the matter?
Ah, I'm sorry. I was just a little lost in my own thoughts. Are you here to buy some clothes?
The high-class silks from Liyue remain out of stock, but we still have the latest kimonos.
You used to import material from Liyue?
Yes. Before, we were often able to secure high-end silk from Liyue such as those that the Feiyun Commerce Guild makes from Silk Flowers.
But with the current situation here, we haven't been able to import that sort of silk in a while now. We've been having to rely on our existing stock to continue operations.
Every bolt of silk we use here is one we're not getting back...
I originally planned to design some novel kimono patterns myself, or use some new dyes to make new cloth and attract customers.
But I can't think of anything that might be considered a "novel" pattern...
Traveler, you've seen a lot, I'm sure. Have you encountered any designs that you might consider "novel"?
I wouldn't say so, exactly...
Ah, I see. Um, this might be rather presumptuous of me, but... could you help me ask other outlanders about patterns that we could use?
I'm the only one running Ogura Textiles & Kimonos at the moment, so I can't leave the store. If I want to gather information, I can only ask others to do it for me.
Leave it to me.
Great, let me think... You should go ask Miss Tang Wen and Mr. Ramsay. Perhaps they will have some new ideas.
This is no way to continue doing business...
Is something the matter?
Ah, I'm sorry. I was just a little lost in my own thoughts. Are you here to buy some clothes?
The high-class silks from Liyue remain out of stock, but we still have the latest kimonos.
You used to import material from Liyue?
Yes. Before, we were often able to secure high-end silk from Liyue such as those that the Feiyun Commerce Guild makes from Silk Flowers.
But at the moment, we have yet to reestablish connections with our suppliers, so we can only work with the stock we still have.
As such, every bolt of silk we use here is one we're not getting back...
I originally planned to design some novel kimono patterns myself, or use some new dyes to make new cloth and attract customers.
Traveler, I'm sure that you've seen a great deal in your journeys. May I ask if you've ever encountered any designs that you might consider "novel"?
I wouldn't say so, exactly...
Ah, I see. Um, this might be rather presumptuous of me, but... could you help me ask other outlanders about for ideas about patterns that we might use in our designs?
I'm the only one running Ogura Textiles & Kimonos at the moment, so I can't leave the store. If I want to gather information, I've can only ask others to do it for me.
Leave it to me.
Great! Now let me think... You could start by asking Ms. Tang Wen and Mr. Ramsay. Perhaps they might have some new ideas.

flow.stepDescription: Ask Tang Wen about the kimonos

dialogs.text: Perhaps Miss Tang Wen and Mr. Ramsay will have some new ideas...
So, do you have any ideas for kimono patterns?
Kimono patterns? I'm afraid I don't know anything about that...
But if you were to ask me... I think that books might look great as a design on a kimono.
Hmm, books printed on kimonos... Now wouldn't that be interesting...
Perhaps Miss Tang Wen and Mr. Ramsay will have some new ideas...
So, do you have any ideas for kimono patterns?
Kimono patterns? Haha, I'm not exactly an expert on that.
But if I were to choose a design, I'd go with tea sets. Those would look neat on a kimono.
A kimono printed with a tea set design... Hahaha, now that certainly would have an Inazuman feel.
So did you ask them about it?
I did.
Great! So what did they say?
Books and... tea sets? That sounds interesting.
But how should we make them exactly? Hmm, I need to give this a bit more thought...
Thank you, Traveler. This information has proved extremely useful to me. Please, accept these as a token of my appreciation.
Perhaps Miss Tang Wen and Mr. Ramsay will have some new ideas...
Ah, hello. I was thinking about something, and I didn't notice you. Sorry.
About the designs on kimonos...
The designs on kimonos? I don't know anything about that...
But if you asked me... I think that books would look great as a design on a kimono.
Print books on a kimono... Hm, now that would be interesting...
Hello, are you an outlander who came to Inazuma too? Ah, we've become a real rare sight recently.
About the designs on kimonos...
Designs on kimonos? Haha, I'm not exactly an expert on that.
But if I were to choose a design, I'd go with tea sets. That would look neat on a kimono.
A kimono printed with a tea set design... Hahaha, now that certainly would have an Inazuman feel.
So did you ask them about it?
I asked them.
Great, so what did they say?
Books and... tea sets? Sounds interesting.
But, how to make it? I need to think more about this...
This information is very useful to me. I'm so grateful. Here's some compensation, please take it.
